title: The Primal Enemy
subtitle: Murder and Intrigue Amidst Wartime Calcutta
summary: As the city of Calcutta reels from the aftershocks of war and communal strife, detective Byomkesh Bakshi finds himself navigating a world where death is never far away. When violence erupts in the shadows of everyday life, Byomkesh must unravel a mystery hidden beneath the city's uneasy calm. Step into a world where survival means outwitting not just enemies, but fate itself.
